notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter, Zaiqa Kitchen, Zaiqa Stock and Zaiqa Staff apps, version 2.38.0.

Owner link 2.0
- The owner link is now a full app page with 6 tabs: Home, Summary, Sales, Staff, Money, Stock.
- Summary like the POS: Shift / Today / Yesterday / Week / Month / Last month / your own dates, filter by Dine In / Take Away / Delivery, comparison with the period before, order-type and payment split, discounts, deleted, expenses and estimated net. Share, PDF and CSV.
- Sales: best and slowest items, categories, most / least profit items, waiters, busiest hours, bill search with items, deleted bills and cancelled items.
- Staff: live attendance board, month totals, and you can Approve / Decline staff requests right from the page.
- Money: cash drawer vs expected, recent shift differences, expenses by category, customer dues, salary advances. Stock: low stock and recent purchases.
- Alerts at the top (late orders, big discounts, deleted bills, cash difference, low stock, absent staff); limits are set in Settings > Cloud > Owner page alerts.
- Choose English or اردو at login (switch any time), dark mode, hide-amounts button.
- Worker update needed for this: say "deploy".
